name: denny-agent-workflows
description: Prepare scoped Denny Office assignments, verified context handoffs between coding-agent sessions, and evidence-based reviews of agent results.

interface.longDescription: Prepare scoped Denny Office assignments, carry verified context between coding-agent sessions, and review delivered work against acceptance criteria. Three skills produce Markdown briefs, handoffs and result reviews from inputs supplied by the user. This is a skills-only package: it does not submit Office records, start agents or control the native Mac application. Made in Russia by AFTEAM.
defaultPrompt: Turn this request into a Denny Office assignment with acceptance criteria.
Prepare a handoff to the next agent, preserving failed checks and blockers.
Review this agent result against the brief and draft a rework request if needed.

publication.release_notes: Initial workflow skills for Office briefs, session handoffs and result reviews.

ru-RU.subtitle: Поручения и контекст агентов
ru-RU.description: Подготовка поручений для Denny Office, передача проверенного контекста между сессиями агентов и разбор результатов по критериям приёмки. Пакет создаёт документы и не отправляет задания или команды в приложение. Сделано в России командой AFTEAM.
